title: Certify all 61 mixed-caller guard allocations and exact tariff regimes
body:
The exact PR6398 mixed caller has **61 componentwise minimal integer guard allocations** for PR6473's sufficient four-class field-error envelope. A general dyadic proof bounds every minimal guard by 39; the actual frontier stops at 16. The search cutoff is proved, not chosen.

The full certificate supports every increasing precision tariff. For the stated error-output digit volume, the optimal scalar/LOCAL/QUERY/idle policies are `(9,8,9,9)`, `(10,7,7,7)`, `(11,6,7,7)` and `(13,6,6,7)`. They switch at native-to-ordinary digit prices **397/130, 397/36 and 794/17**. At prices 1, 10, 100 the optimal model volumes are 4,284, 9,780, 57,961, compared with uniform nine's 4,320, 11,043, 78,273. These are model optima, not measured physical savings or a new kappa.

Every literal error site is included: 437 scalar primitive sites, 36 LOCAL outputs, 17 QUERY outputs and 30 idle outputs. Counting each normalizer's four half-field operations gives field-equivalent weights `(397,36,17,30)`. Exact SWAP/Q_POWER operations are outside this defect-volume tariff and are not claimed physically free. Native range, routing, conversions, cleanup and actual cost functions remain separate.

Evidence at `8ae433ea3484c24c2547e26d1cc5f764c7c31fd9`: exact source envelope regeneration; two enumerations using different eliminated coordinates and rational/integer arithmetic; all 244 failing immediate decreases; all 34 output rows; 84 microdomains with 109,525 tuples beyond their proved bounds; exact tariff intervals/ties and 128 additional positive tariff vectors; seven invalid cases and seven source-byte corruptions. Warning-strict CPython 3.12.13 normal/optimized registered checks, committed bytes/modes, official export and both sealed read-only, Git-free, empty-PATH replays pass. Hosted planning and replay passed at the published head: [run 41577739099](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41577739099).

Retain [PR6510](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6510)'s normalizer correction: the four half-field operations and their internal bound require a compatible translation pair, with Q² equal to its pair swap. For arbitrary Q^4=I, the completed-normalizer defect allowance is an explicit premise. The frontier optimizes the inherited sufficient envelope, not the exact physical error model. This older mixed caller is not selected PR6030. All five framework assumptions, native/tape/compiler/outer admission and independent scientific review remain open. No selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run is claimed. The checkout is shallow; full-history ancestry is not certified.

Start with [PROOF.md](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8ae433ea3484c24c2547e26d1cc5f764c7c31fd9/research/mixed-caller-guard-frontier/PROOF.md), [RESULT.json](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8ae433ea3484c24c2547e26d1cc5f764c7c31fd9/research/mixed-caller-guard-frontier/RESULT.json), and the [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19366097). Main 7c49fe32, revision 8 and selected6030 were refreshed. Overlap covered 490 open PRs and 6,483 Discussion records, then current live handoffs before submission. The active selected-word stochastic join and PR6477's different-source two-rate frontier remain separate. Sparse local notes, unpublished work and non-atomic changes remain limits.

Credit Ali Romman PR6473 at 15a7e8d2e90f23977393613e6d0889614b144ad7, PR6477 and PR6398/6348; ToikY PR6510 at 62bbf6da28ee686698d979ad9f0945f707726c9a and PR6433; Cinna Davis and all retained native/compiler authors. Exact source proofs, code, word and original credit are retained. Classical product order, precision allocation and affine tariff comparisons retain credit. New bound, frontier and checks: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge or closure requested.
